verdict.rationale: The firm lists both O-1 extraordinary-ability visas and EB-1 extraordinary-ability green cards as practice areas, so it offers the green-card step itself. It does not document a strategy linking the O-1 to that green card. missing for 10: any EB-2 NIW offering, a documented O-1-to-green-card continuation strategy, founder-specific EB-1A guidance, independent or client corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the provider documents the green-card continuation — EB-1A or EB-2 NIW strategy after the work visa — so the O-1 is a path, not a dead end

citations.quote: EB-1: Green Card based on Extraordinary Ability, Outstanding professors and researchers, or Multinational manager or executive
